title.id: UU No. 13 Tahun 2016 tentang Paten (sebelum perubahan UU No. 65 Tahun 2024)
title.en: Law No. 13 of 2016 on Patents (before the Law No. 65 of 2024 amendment)

verification.note: Rule values compiled from secondary commentary. Must be confirmed against the official text by Indonesian counsel before production use. Late-payment grace under this regime was described as up to 12 months on request with a 100% surcharge; sources differ.

working_statement.note: No annual Working Statement obligation modelled before Law No. 65/2024.
